body: Forward test of the sector cycle/lead indicator method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.45 (naive base rate 0.55) that: TVS Motor total sales volume for Jan–Mar 2027 grows ≥15% YoY. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (Nov-2026): Q2 volume 1.9 mn vs 1.5 mn (+27%); revenue +44%; domestic ICE 2W +16% vs industry +10%; 2W exports +33%; EV 2W +129%; 3W +47%. Management: 'You will see much higher growth from TVS in quarter 3 and quarter 4.' Macro: repo hikes, El Niño rural stress, high fuel prices; Jan–Mar 2026 base is elevated by the post-GST-cut demand surge. Reasoning: Share gains and exports are real, but the base quarter (Jan–Mar 2026) was strong and the rate/rural cycle is turning against two-wheelers. Lean slightly below base. Resolution: YES if the sum of TVS Motor's reported total sales (2W + 3W, domestic + exports, incl. EV) for Jan, Feb and Mar 2027 ÷ the same sum for Jan–Mar 2026 − 1 ≥ 15.0%, per TVS monthly sales press releases. Source: TVS Motor monthly sales press releases (NSE announcements), Jan–Mar 2027. Resolve by 2027-04-15; score with Brier vs base rate.
